name: Arienzo
what: The home parish. The Collegiate Church of Sant'Andrea Apostolo holds baptisms from 1672, marriages from 1754 and deaths from 1733. Every Falco generation from Pasquale to Raffaele was born, married and buried here.

name: San Felice a Cancello
what: Birthplace of Angela Rosa Morgillo, who married into the line in the 1840s. The next comune west of Arienzo.

name: Arpaia
what: Across the provincial border, four kilometres from Arienzo. Gerardo Falco was born here in 1913; the Zampiello family were here through the 1920s and 1930s.

name: Forchia
what: Where Carmine Falco was born in 1930. The comune takes its name from the Forche Caudine — the Caudine Forks, where the Roman army was made to pass under the yoke in 321 BC.

name: Benevento
what: Where Carmine Falco and Francesca Zampiello married, and where Giuseppina was born in 1955. Capital of the Lombard duchy that gave southern Italy the personal name Falco.

name: Brisbane
what: Where the line arrives. Carminantonio Falco and Filomena Annecchino are buried at Nudgee Cemetery.
